title: Share foreign Delta tables with OpenSharing (Public Preview)
body: You can now use OpenSharing to share foreign Delta tables, which are Delta-format tables registered in a foreign catalog such as OneLake, a Hive metastore, or AWS Glue. Providers add foreign Delta tables to a share, and recipients access the shared data in read-only format. See [Add foreign Delta tables to a share](/aws/en/opensharing/create-share#foreign-delta).
